mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (indicating active monetary easing) reduces the risk-free rate and compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a severe labor market deterioration that triggers recessionary fears, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based collapse in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1.0% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (indicated by rising federal funds rates), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising (by more than 0.25pp in 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of industrial production (indicating reduced manufacturing output) signals a deteriorating economic cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400.0 thousand units indicate a severe housing market contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1400.0.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines by more than 0.5% and UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (indicated by declining industrial production), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate output and profit growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.
